items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: He was one of the most beautiful people. He said the most marvelous things to you.

ctx.x: And Cannonball. Julian “Cannonball” Adderley. Yes. Happy, happy.
Yes that was a great recording. People just praised it to the skies. Do you have favorites?
